activation_policy: EVERY candidate here is status=under_review and needs_reviewer=true. None of these may be written into tax_rules with status='active'. Activation requires a verified official_source AND an approved tax_rule_reviews row with a licensed reviewer, per server/lib/taxGate.js. Values marked confidence=low were read from DJP guidance page summaries, NOT from the primary regulation text, and must be confirmed against the PMK/PP.

compliance_rule_candidates.obligation: Business must hold a NIB issued through OSS as its single business identity
compliance_rule_candidates.notes: Underlying law cited as UU 11/2020 (Cipta Kerja) via BKPM guidance; primary text NOT retrieved. | 2026-09-02: OSS pages archived and title-confirmed (OSS_001, OSS_003, OSS_KBLI_001) but they are client-rendered SPAs — the archived bytes contain no substantive content. BKPM_OSS_001 was UNREACHABLE (DNS). No new support obtained.

compliance_rule_candidates.notes: KBLI code determines risk tier and therefore which licences are required. compliance_rule_candidates.obligation: Investment companies must submit periodic LKPM investment activity reports
compliance_rule_candidates.applies_to: investment companies above an investment-value threshold
compliance_rule_candidates.notes: Cited basis: UU 25/2007 Pasal 15 and Peraturan BKPM 6/2020. The threshold (Rp500,000,000) and the 10th-of-month deadline appear in a 2021 period-specific announcement and MUST NOT be generalised to today without checking the current Perka.

compliance_rule_candidates.obligation: Employers must register themselves and their workers with BPJS
compliance_rule_candidates.notes: Cited basis: UU 24/2011. Registration described as requiring NIB or business licence plus NPWP. Covers BPJS Ketenagakerjaan; BPJS Kesehatan sources were NOT collected — GAP.
